provenance_phrase_audit.text: Prediction disagreement is widely used as reliability evidence, yet common error can cancel from a prediction difference. We study this failure in deterministic MRI inter-slice interpolation, where the physical anchors supporting one missing target can be controlled. Across 24 fastMRI brain examinations, 115 IXI brain examinations, and eight patient clusters from NingXia knee MRI, target-preserving disjoint contexts improve error ranking over dependence-preserving controls by $\Delta\rho=.092/.095/.193$. Under clean sharing, only 2.61/1.58/0.25\% of paired-error energy remains observable. A prospectively frozen $\times4$ test spans HAT, SwinIR, I3Net, an adapted SAINT-style network, and an internal CycleINR-style model. Every architecture has positive disjoint-minus-shared observable gain on fastMRI (8.0--22.6 points) and an independent IXI replication (25.2--30.2 points); all 115 IXI case effects per model are positive. Examination-ranking gains remain cohort dependent. An exact analytical ladder also falsifies anchor count as a monotone explanation: local estimator influence is more informative, but its finite-response approximation is not stable or superior for every architecture. A 125-case external MR angiography experiment tests acquired-only score support with fixed analytical estimators. Retrospective benefit audits retain a degraded-model exception and expose sensitivity to score--endpoint scale agreement. Exploratory controls retain local gains under simultaneous inference but weaken ranking and benefit claims. The contribution is a bounded error-geometry mechanism, not calibrated uncertainty or prospective acquisition benefit.
provenance_phrase_audit.decision: remove prospective/prespecified/rule-frozen; held-out only from estimator fitting; independent refers to distinct cohort, not untouched analysis

provenance_phrase_audit.text: Our contributions are threefold. First, we establish and decompose \emph{consensus blindness} with same-target, measurement-controlled interventions across three MRI cohorts and a prospectively frozen five-architecture replication on two independent brain cohorts. Second, we show that local estimator influence refines raw overlap for analytical estimators and stable HAT/SwinIR/SAINT probes, while retaining the SAINT fixed-count uncertainty, NingXia nonreplication, physical-plane dependence, and I3Net/CycleINR stability failures as scope boundaries. Third, we test a lightweight acquired-anchor consequence with same-model $\times4\!\rightarrow\!\times2$ comparisons across a recovered model bank, without claiming score uniqueness or acquisition causality. The main result is a falsifiable mechanism for when disagreement is informative, not another uncertainty leaderboard.
provenance_phrase_audit.decision: remove prospective/prespecified/rule-frozen; held-out only from estimator fitting; independent refers to distinct cohort, not untouched analysis

provenance_phrase_audit.text: We use 24 held-out fastMRI brain T2 examinations \cite{knoll2020fastmri}, 115 held-out IXI brain T2 examinations \cite{ixi_dataset}, and 22 out-of-fold NingXia knee T2 series from eight patients. NingXia inference resamples patients with all subordinate series retained. Frozen HAT and SwinIR $\times4$ reconstructions test the original nonlinear influence claim; linear and cubic interpolation provide analytical support. The architecture falsification adds locally trained I3Net, adapted SAINT-style, and internal CycleINR-style checkpoints. They test architecture lineage, not exact official implementations or weights. Phase-0 wrappers reproduce all 24 fastMRI outputs per model and one frozen IXI examination per model exactly. The five-architecture clean shared/disjoint experiment uses all 24 fastMRI and 115 IXI examinations, with five residue-balanced targets per IXI examination. fastMRI and NingXia additionally have common-support $\times2/\times4$ outputs for 13 recovered models and enter a rule-frozen same-model retrospective consequence audit. Dense volumes supply retrospective anchors and targets. A DICOM audit verifies physical slice order for all 24 fastMRI test cases; their legacy affine alone does not preserve patient orientation. Input-only scores use acquired anchors; the five-architecture intervention uses target-derived masks, while bank scores use target-model prediction masks. These supports are evaluated separately.
provenance_phrase_audit.decision: remove prospective/prespecified/rule-frozen; held-out only from estimator fitting; independent refers to distinct cohort, not untouched analysis

provenance_phrase_audit.text: Given acquired anchors $x_0,x_4,x_8,\ldots$, Anchor-CV withholds each interior $x_{4j}$, predicts it linearly from $x_{4(j-1)}$ and $x_{4(j+1)}$, and returns the median masked residual. It uses only acquired slices, no additional trained model, and zero neural calls. We compare it with adjacent-anchor MAE/RMSE and output-based scores. Matching model identity does not hold factor-specific learned weights fixed. The retrospective benefit endpoint is common-support $\mathrm{MAE}_{\times4}-\mathrm{MAE}_{\times2}$ for the same dataset, case, fold, model, and support. Frozen scores are Anchor-CV, adjacent-anchor MAE, and the median $\times4$ disagreement between the target model and registry-declared candidate-bank members. Every model with finite paired errors is retained. Budgets are fixed at 10/20/30/50\% and report gain above random and oracle-normalized gain. Because the dense acquisitions and reconstruction outputs predate this rule-frozen audit, it is explicitly retrospective and exploratory.
provenance_phrase_audit.decision: remove prospective/prespecified/rule-frozen; held-out only from estimator fitting; independent refers to distinct cohort, not untouched analysis

provenance_phrase_audit.text: A prespecified stability audit strengthens this interpretation. All 42 amplitude, sign/field, and direction-count strata pass the rank-stability gate (minimum $\rho=.942$). Physical-plane rank stability is .779--.954 and only one of three plane-pair gates passes. The response statistic is numerically stable at a declared target/plane but not a plane-invariant global property.
provenance_phrase_audit.decision: remove prospective/prespecified/rule-frozen; held-out only from estimator fitting; independent refers to distinct cohort, not untouched analysis

provenance_phrase_audit.text: Figure~\ref{fig:arch} separates the robust local endpoint from its cohort-dependent ranking consequence. On fastMRI, disjoint-minus-shared observable-error gain is 17.8/17.6/8.0/13.7/22.6 points for HAT/SwinIR/I3Net/SAINT/CycleINR; all clustered intervals exclude zero. The independently frozen IXI replication gives 29.0/30.2/25.2/29.8/29.6 points, with all five intervals above zero and all 115 case effects positive for every model. Reflection-balanced identity-swap estimates remain 29.2/30.0/25.1/29.7/29.5 points, and all five mirror-difference intervals include zero. The IXI equal-weight four-family estimate is 28.6 points; leave-one-family-out estimates remain 28.1--29.7 points. Phase-0 wrapper maximum error is zero for all ten cohort--model runs.
provenance_phrase_audit.decision: remove prospective/prespecified/rule-frozen; held-out only from estimator fitting; independent refers to distinct cohort, not untouched analysis

provenance_phrase_audit.text: The influence probe also identifies a boundary rather than a clean five-model replication. SAINT passes all amplitude/sign gates (minimum $\rho=.940$); its broad influence association is .706 [.680,.734] with error cosine and $-.698$ [$-.730$,$-.666$] with observable fraction. Yet influence exceeds count for error cosine by only .014 [$-.002$,.029], and its exact-one-overlap, geometry/examination-adjusted estimate is .063 [$-.021$,.149]. I3Net and CycleINR fail the prospectively frozen stability gate and are classified as phenomenon-only. Hence stable non-transformer influence is directionally consistent, but ``influence beats count across all architectures'' is falsified.
provenance_phrase_audit.decision: remove prospective/prespecified/rule-frozen; held-out only from estimator fitting; independent refers to distinct cohort, not untouched analysis

provenance_phrase_audit.text: Architecture diversity is not synonymous with independent failure. At fastMRI $\times4$, the median examination error-rank correlation among the prospectively frozen five models is .981, and six of 24 cases are in the top error quartile for all five. An exploratory full-bank audit in the supplement expands this to seven cohort--factor strata, 6--13 recovered models per stratum, and 483 pairs: every stratum's median case-error rank correlation exceeds .93. Cross-family pairing improves disagreement--error ranking for some implicit targets but is neutral or adverse for others. Pixelwise error cosine is lower for CycleINR--I3Net (.564 median) than HAT--SwinIR (.918), showing that local error diversity can increase even while case difficulty remains shared.
provenance_phrase_audit.decision: remove prospective/prespecified/rule-frozen; held-out only from estimator fitting; independent refers to distinct cohort, not untouched analysis

provenance_phrase_audit.text: The native evaluator measures every nonacquired plane on the whole image, averages planes within an examination, and then averages examinations. NingXia first averages series within a held-out patient fold, then averages all eight folds. PSNR uses each target plane's range; SSIM is the full-plane implementation. These are reference-based evaluation metrics, not deployable QA scores. Each configuration has matching case identities and generated-plane counts across its models; this count audit does not independently certify all historical preprocessing. The old masked common-support tables and this native-metric ledger remain distinct contracts. Automatic threshold-mask Dice/HD95 columns are not interpreted as anatomical segmentation.
provenance_phrase_audit.decision: remove prospective/prespecified/rule-frozen; held-out only from estimator fitting; independent refers to distinct cohort, not untouched analysis

provenance_phrase_audit.text: The independent units are 24 fastMRI examinations, 115 IXI examinations, and eight NingXia patients containing 22 series. All NingXia intervals resample patients with subordinate series, planes, models, and contexts retained. Missing target values are not subtracted in a disagreement score, but its evaluation support can be target-derived. Plan 9/11 use a ground-truth 1\% mask; the recovered bank uses the target model's prediction mask, not ground truth. Anchor-CV uses held-out acquired anchors (including their masks); adjacent MAE uses masks from acquired pairs. These information regimes must not be conflated.

provenance_phrase_audit.text: The architecture hypothesis and falsification conditions were frozen before new P0 results. Phase-0 anchors are $\{0,4,8,12\}$, phase-2 anchors are $\{2,6,10,14\}$, and common missing targets are $\{3,5,7,9,11\}$. The clean shared control applies an in-plane horizontal flip to phase-0 inputs and maps outputs back. A one-case smoke using through-plane reversal was rejected before cohort inference because it changed physical geometry and exposed direction non-equivariance; its outputs are retained but excluded. Regenerated phase-0 outputs match stored predictions exactly for every one of 24 cases and all five architectures (pixel MAE and maximum absolute difference zero).

On common case support within each cohort and factor, it covers 6--13 models, 483 undirected error pairs, and 807 directed target--member disagreement pairs. Independent bootstrap units are examinations for fastMRI/IXI and patient folds for NingXia.

Each of the five phase-0 wrappers reproduces one frozen IXI examination (IXI012) with zero maximum absolute error; this is a wrapper gate, not a 115-case reproduction audit. The resulting plane table contains exactly 5,750 rows (five models, 115 examinations, five targets, two conditions), with no duplicate keys or non-finite metric values.

provenance_phrase_audit.text: The rule-frozen consequence audit instead matches model identity while allowing factor-specific weights. It pairs common-support $\times4$ and $\times2$ MAE for every eligible model on fastMRI and patient-folded NingXia. Anchor-CV is positively associated with benefit for 13/13 fastMRI models and 12/13 NingXia models (median within-model $\rho=.851/.727$); adjacent MAE gives 13/13 and 12/13 (.802/.748), and candidate-bank disagreement gives 11/11 and 10/11 (.835/.710). The smaller bank denominator is structural: the precomputation includes neural targets only; Linear/Cubic are candidate members but not target rows. The only non-positive model is the severely degraded NingXia Res-SRDiff run; all three intervals cross zero. No model is removed by result direction.

critical_findings: One fastMRI patient crosses train/validation; no train/test or validation/test ID overlap.
Plan9/11 disagreement evaluated inside GT mask; probe normalization uses full examination including targets. Not target-free.
Plan9 stable-wrong thresholds estimated on reported test planes; Plan8 uses different thresholds. Descriptive test-relative prevalence, not externally validated detection.
Historical primary endpoint shifted from ranking (Plan9) toward local observability (Plan11 onward). New main story is retrospective; local gain is not a newly preregistered primary success.
42-stratum HAT/SwinIR stability and new-model .90 gate are audited stability descriptions; no independent proof all gates were chosen before any outcomes.
Plane-level repeated measures require examination/patient bootstrap, family counts do not add patient sample size.
CAS/TopCoW results and all historical cohorts have already been inspected; no truly untouched inference cohort established.
OAI-prepared is label-like, MRNet independent patient linkage missing; do not force external validation with these resources.

New source correction: HAT/SwinIR and Plan9 neural influence use sum of shared response inner products divided by all-anchor response energies, NOT mean of individual response cosines. Main and supplementary must use the actual formula.
Original clean ranking pools planes/models against fixed phase0 error; cluster bootstrap does not make the point estimate case-level.
Historical broad influence includes 966 self-pairs; the new explicitly post-hoc non-self sensitivity retains all six positive simultaneous advantages.
